Lydia Christensen

Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate, Michigan · Open seat

Computer scientist and technology founder (Iron Fortress LLC)

Lydia Christensen is a computer scientist and technology founder from Ironwood, in Michigan's Upper Peninsula, who says she grew up in the foster care system. The Libertarian Party of Michigan nominated her for U.S. Senate at its June 28, 2026 convention, and the party certified her nomination for the November 3, 2026 general election. She is running for the open seat held by Sen. Gary Peters, who is not seeking reelection, under the campaign name "Unchaining Michigan."

Where Christensen stands

Civil liberties / digital privacy
Says her top Senate priority would be protecting digital privacy and civil liberties through a comprehensive Digital Bill of Rights.
Campaign finance
Says she takes no corporate PAC money. She also says she is "disgusted" by a PAC with ties to the El-Sayed campaign that sent texts promoting her candidacy.
Immigration
Says due process applies to everyone on American soil, citizen or not, and opposes detaining anyone without it.
Surveillance
Opposes warrantless surveillance and facial recognition dragnets, including the warrantless tracing of cars and the monitoring of protesters.
Health care
Supports "Medicaid for All," which she describes as comprehensive coverage with $0 deductibles. A Libertarian Party profile describes her plan as opt-in rather than mandatory.
Taxes
Supports ending the federal income tax on earnings under $150,000, according to the Washington Free Beacon.
Press freedom
Calls for White House press access to be restored for CNN, MS NOW and Politico. Proposes stronger protections for journalists who cover the federal government.
Campaign priorities
Says her plan focuses on Great Lakes protection, housing, tribal sovereignty, civil liberties and economic opportunity.

Background

  • Libertarian Party of Michigan nominee for U.S. Senate, nominated June 28, 2026
  • No prior elected office found
  • Founder of Iron Fortress LLC, a technology company focused on Bitcoin mining, AI compute, manufacturing and connectivity
  • Education: says she earned the equivalent of two degrees in computer science and computer programming; graduated from Appleton West High School (per Votebook)
  • Raised in the foster care system; lives in Ironwood, Michigan; describes herself as a member of the Kiowa-Sioux Nation
